Rooms.Name: A long tunnel
Rooms.Description:
You encounter some rapids as you enter this tunnel cut out of the
mountains by the river.

Rooms.Name: A long tunnel
Rooms.Description: The tunnel branches off north.

Rooms.Name: A long tunnel
Rooms.Description: The tunnel branches off south.

Rooms.Name: A long tunnel
Rooms.Description: The tunnel branches off to the south.

Rooms.Name: An underground lake
Rooms.Description:
A underground lake opens up eastly. It looks seminatural as most have
been carved by eons of flowing water but some parts have been, improved,
chopped away by someone who did not think this lake was large enough.
Small passages lead off both south and north while the dark river takes
you westly.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The lake is jet-black and there is a constant dripping of water and lime
from above.

Rooms.Name: A long narrow drainage tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel descends slightly to the east to allow possible drained
water to pour easily. The tunnel walls are close and you can almost feel
the narrowing even more to the east. Westly you can hear the distant
sound of water dripping.

Rooms.Name: A long narrow drainage tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel descends slightly to the east and then abruptly dives down
into a brightly lit hole. This must be where all drain water go. What can
soak up such amounts of water? Westly,and slightly up the drain tunnel
continue.

Rooms.Name: Cave-in
Rooms.Description:
You stand at the edge of a large pile of rubble created from the last
rock slide.

Exits.Description: You can easily slide down the rocks without getting hurt.

Rooms.Name: At the foot of the rubble
Rooms.Description:
You are at the bottom of a large pile of rubble. A tunnel branches off
to the north and east.

Rooms.Name: Cave entrance
Rooms.Description:
You stand in the middle of a large and beautiful cave. A path leads
deeper into the darkness.

Exits.Description: You look down into the cave. Bones are strewn about everywhere.

Rooms.Name: Giant cave
Rooms.Description:
This cavern overwhelms you. The walls and ceiling seem miles away.
Bones of previous adventurers lie strewn on the cavern floor.

Rooms.Name: Narrow bend
Rooms.Description: The tunnel turns to the south and west.

Rooms.Name: Large cave
Rooms.Description:
You are standing in a large cave. Many furs are spread out on the
floor.

Rooms.Name: Damp hallway
Rooms.Description: The walls here are extremely damp, as well as the floor.

Exits.Description: You hear drops of water.

Rooms.Name: Underground pool
Rooms.Description: You are wading in a knee deep pool of lime-water.

Rooms.Name: Damp hallway
Rooms.Description:
The walls of the tunnel are extremely damp here. You hear the faint
sound of running water to the south.

Exits.Description: You hear drops of water.

Rooms.Name: Narrow crawlway
Rooms.Description:
This crawlway is just big enough for a human to crawl through or a
halfling to walk through.

Exits.Description: You smell the fragrant odor of fungus.

Rooms.Name: Large cavern
Rooms.Description:
You have entered a very large cavern. The rock formations would amaze
almost any dwarf.

Rooms.Name: Fungus patch
Rooms.Description:
As you walk through the fungus patch, you are shot at by many millions
of spores. You can hardly breathe.

Exits.Description: The fragrant smell of fungus spores continues to the east.

Rooms.Name: Fungus path
Rooms.Description:
As you walk along the path, millions of spores are shot at you. It is
difficult to breathe.

Exits.Description: A giant mushroom temple stands to the south.
The fragrant smell of spores continues to the west.

Rooms.Name: Fungus temple
Rooms.Description:
You find yourself standing inside of a giant mushroom. The inside is
decorated in the fashion of a temple.

Rooms.Name: Sloping passage
Rooms.Description: You follow a path sloping down from the fungus temple.

Rooms.Name: Sloping passage
Rooms.Description: You are on a path that gently slops up from the underground pool.

Exits.Description: You hear sounds of trickling water.

Rooms.Name: The Great Eastern Desert
Rooms.Description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sand constantly shifting around
you. A pyramid lies to the east and a snow-capped mountain range to the
west.

Exits.Description: Sand as far as the eye can see.

Exits.Description:

Rooms.Name: A nomad camp
Rooms.Description:
This small group of desert nomads has stopped for the day to rest and
refresh themselves beside this beautiful oasis. Three tents and some
camels make up the party. From within two of the tents you hear muffled
voices, obviously surprised at your visit.

Exits.Description: Some camels are tied up to a mass of stakes plugged into the ground.

You see inside one of the tents a huddled mass of people, probably
slaves.
Sand as far as the eye can see.
Sand as far as the eye can see.

Rooms.Name: Inside a small tent
Rooms.Description:
This is a small and simple tent with few possessions in sight. Lying
here and there are young-looking men and women, possibly slaves to the
leader of this band.

Exits.Description: You see the center of the nomad camp.

Rooms.Name: Beside the camels
Rooms.Description:
Here stand about ten camels, all hitched to some stakes plugged into
the ground. To the east you see a small tent while to the north you see a
larger, fancier tent.

Exits.Description:
This tent seems to be the temporary abode of the nomad leader. You make a
mental note to visit it before you leave.
In this tent there are very large men, all carrying weapons.
You see the center of the nomad camp.
Sand as far as the eye can see.

Rooms.Name: The warrior's tent
Rooms.Description:
This tent has a few furnishings, but mainly it holds the band's
protectors. They all stare at you coldly as you enter.

Exits.Description: Outside you see some peaceful camels.

Rooms.Name: The main tent
Rooms.Description:
This tent is as lavishly decorated on the inside as it is on the
outside. A fancy carpet lies on the sand and numerous baskets line the
walls.

Exits.Description: You see some peaceful camels.

Rooms.Name: The main tent
Rooms.Description:
This is where the leader of this band of nomads resides. He is
definitely rich as you inspect the tapestries, baskets, and a few
paintings as well.

Exits.Description: You see the entrance to this tent.

Rooms.Name: The rickety rope bridge
Rooms.Description:
You carefully begin to walk across the bridge, but suddenly the rope
breaks and you fall...

... and fall and fall and fall ...

                to your death on the rocks below.

Rooms.Name: The wind-swept ledge
Rooms.Description:
Being very careful not to lose your balance, you look around and find
that this canyon is about a half a kilometer deep. To the west is a dark
cave leading under the desert sands and above you a rope bridge spans the
gap.

Exits.Description: The desert sands blow down in your face.

Rooms.Name: The cavemouth
Rooms.Description:
The air in here is MUCH cooler than outside. From the west you hear
strange sounds, but can see nothing. The cave slopes down into the
darkness.

Exits.Description: Outside is lighter and very windy.

Rooms.Name: The mysterious lair
Rooms.Description:
You have stumbled upon the home of something. From the treasure
haphazardly strewn about and the rotting carcasses, you would guess that
this is a dragon's lair. As to what type, you can't really say. The cave
narrows out into a tunnel to the west.

Rooms.Name: A wide tunnel
Rooms.Description:
This tunnel seems to go on forever into the darkness. You carefully
feel your way along the walls.

Rooms.Name: A narrower tunnel
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel becomes very narrow and you fight to squeeze your way
through. The floor seems to level off a little.

Rooms.Name: A narrow crack
Rooms.Description:
This part of the tunnel is the hardest to move through as the walls
move in to meet you.

Rooms.Name: A small cavern
Rooms.Description:
It is dark and damp and bats hang from the ceiling. A narrow crack is
in the east wall. The floor now slopes upwards.

Rooms.Name: A small shaft
Rooms.Description:
From within this shaft you can see a narrow hole in the roof just
large enough for one person. Back east is the cavern.

Rooms.Name: The Great Eastern Desert
Rooms.Description:
A vast desert stretches for miles, the sands constantly shifting
around you. You are standing below a gigantic pyramid floating about 100
meters above the ground. To your left hangs a rope which leads straight
up to the massive structure. From here you can sense the great evil which
resides within.

Exits.Description: Sand as far as the eye can see.
Sand as far as the eye can see.
Sand as far as the eye can see.
Sand as far as the eye can see.

The rope leads up to a hole in the pyramid. A shadowy figure hovers over
the rope looking down at you.

Rooms.Name: Hanging on the rope
Rooms.Description:
About half way up the rope you feel it begin to shake and shudder. You
desperately try to shimmy back down the rope, but it unravels and...
SNAP!!!!!
As you plummet to the ground, you look up to see a shadowy figure in the
pyramid grinning an evil grin and brandishing a shiny dagger.

Exits.Description: A looooong way down.

Rooms.Name: Lost in the Desert
Rooms.Description:
Blinking to clear the sand from your eyes, you try and get some idea
of where you are. The problem is, every direction looks the same sand
as far as the eye can see, and a haze of sandy dust hanging over
everything. You have heard that people wandering in the desert
see mirages, which is undoubtably what that long stairway is, just on
the horizon, after all - who would build a stairway in the middle of
the desert?

Exits.Description: You can't see much through the desert haze.
You can't see much through the desert haze.
You can't see much through the desert haze.
You can't see much through the desert haze.

Rooms.Name: South west corner of a underground lake
Rooms.Description:
The underground lake continues north and east. The seminatural cave
have been carved by eons of flowing water but some parts have been,
improved, chopped away by someone who did not think this lake was large
enough.

Rooms.Name: On a underground lake
Rooms.Description:
The dark water lie almost still with the exception of whatever stir
you might cause. Looking around in the cave you are in you can see from
the roof that it is only seminatural as someone has been improving
transportability over this lake by removing, what you think were, certain
stone formations. The route is now open for whoever sails these dark 
waters. The lake surround you in all horizontal directions.

Rooms.Name: North west corner of a underground lake
Rooms.Description:
The underground lake continues south and east. The seminatural cave
have been carved by eons of flowing water but some parts have been,
improved, chopped away by someone who did not think this lake was large
enough.

Rooms.Name: Up on a buoy metal construct
Rooms.Description:
The metal construct is bolted into the very cave ceiling, causing the
buoy to be fixated. As you think of it, you realize that there is no
other way if you want to measure the water level. If it was floating it
would just follow the surface. A work of dwarf geniousity, be sure of it.

Rooms.Name: Below a buoy
Rooms.Description:
The buoy is NOT fixated to anything. How could it then measure the
water level. If it floats it just floats revealing nothing!
Around you the water is dark, but you can still see a pile of rubble
lying on the lake bed.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
A large load of stones. As you examine it closer you notice a skeletal
hand streching out from below it.

On the rather large hand, at least seen with human standards, you see a
rusty knuckle duster. Engraved on it is, still today clearly visible, the
name 'GRIFO'. Poor bugger. You leave him and his belongings be as you are
pretty sure that someone was rather displeased with him.

Rooms.Name: A small quay
Rooms.Description:
Apperantly this part of the underground lake is travelled by people 
that actually use this shipping route. They frequently anchor up here 
while waiting for something, perhaps their turn in line or they are just 
readying their ship for a longer journey. The cave wall is smooth and 
there are clear signs that someone has improved this part of the 
underground cave to better fit ships. Toward the north the underground 
lake stretches out its dark arms.

Rooms.Name: On a underground lake
Rooms.Description:
The dark water lie almost still with the exception of whatever stir
you might cause. Looking around in the cave you are in you can see from
the roof that it is only seminatural as someone has been improving
transportability over this lake by removing, what you think were, certain
stone formations. The route is now open for whoever sails these dark 
waters. The lake surround you in all horizontal directions.

Rooms.Name: Next to a buoy
Rooms.Description:
In the centre of the underground lake a large buoy floats. It has got
colourful circles painted around its body and on top there is a high
metal construct with some signs on, that reach up to the cave ceiling.
Around you the dark water strech out in all directions as far as you can
see.

Exits.Description: You can climb the metal construct on top of the buoy.
You can dive down into the water and examine how the buoy is fixated.

ExtraDescriptions.Description:
The lines are most presumably water level indicators, showing how deep
down it is to the cave ground.

The signs read :

                                *Midgaard*


*Dwarven Undermountain Harbour Town*            *Drainage*


                                  *Quay*


On the *drainage* sign someone has scrabbled down som more text.

"Griffo Orc was heere"

Obviously some kind of vandal that wanted to be know. But you never heard
of him so one could guess he never really succeded.

Rooms.Name: On a underground lake
Rooms.Description:
The dark water lie almost still with the exception of whatever stir
you might cause. Looking around in the cave you are in you can see from
the roof that it is only seminatural as someone has been improving 
transportability over this lake by removing, what you think were, certain 
stone formations. Now the ceiling is high enough for sailing ships 
even though there is no wind. The lake surround you in all horizontal
directions, but north, where a small channel leads off into the mountain.

Rooms.Name: On a underground water channel
Rooms.Description:
The water channel is wide enough only for one vessel, so you better
hope that noone bigger than you is going the opposite direction. The
channel coninue north while it seems to open up to the south.

Rooms.Name: South east corner of a underground lake
Rooms.Description:
The underground lake continues north and west. The seminatural cave
have been carved by eons of flowing water but some parts have been,
improved, chopped away by someone who did not think this lake was large
enough.

Rooms.Name: On a underground lake
Rooms.Description:
The dark water lie almost still with the exception of whatever stir
you might cause. Looking around in the cave you are in you can see from
the roof that it is only seminatural, as someone has been improving
transportability over this lake by removing, what you think were, certain
stone formations. The route is now open for whoever sails these dark
waters. The lake surround you in all horizontal directions.

Rooms.Name: Northeast corner of a underground lake
Rooms.Description:
The underground lake continues south and west. The seminatural cave
have been carved by eons of flowing water but some parts have been,
improved, chopped away by someone who did not think this lake was large
enough.

Rooms.Name: East side of a underground lake
Rooms.Description:
A small drain have been carved out, making a small tunnel that lead 
off eastly into the mountain, from the eastmost part of a underground lake
that strech out westly. The drain is probably used during the spring
flood to limit the water level of this underground basin.

Rooms.Name: A water channel
Rooms.Description:
The submountain water channel leads you north or south depending of
your targeted destination and of course depending on the big traffic
ships, that one has to avoid in the narrow tunnel. If one of them come 
down the channel, you are clearly a potential wallsmear. There really is 
no room to meet, so the biggest vessel goes first, or through if unlucky..

Rooms.Name: A water channel
Rooms.Description:
The submountain water channel leads you north or south depending of
your targeted destination and of course depending on the big traffic
ships that one has to avoid in the narrow tunnel. There really is no room
to meet, so the biggest vessel goes first.

Rooms.Name: A water channel
Rooms.Description:
The submountain water channel leads you east or south depending of
your targeted destination and of course depending on the big traffic
ships that one has to avoid in the narrow tunnel. There really is no room
to meet, so the biggest vessel, or the ones with the biggest fog horn,
goes first.

Rooms.Name: A water channel
Rooms.Description:
The submountain water channel leads you west or north depending of
your targeted destination and of course depending on the big traffic
ships that one has to avoid in the narrow tunnel. There really is no room
to meet, so what appears to be the biggest vessel, goes first.

Rooms.Name: A water channel
Rooms.Description:
The submountain water channel leads you north or south depending of
your targeted destination and of course depending on the big traffic
ships, that one has to avoid in the narrow tunnel. Be on your guard for 
large waves or the warning sound of a ship fog horn.

Rooms.Name: A water channel
Rooms.Description:
The tunnel is quite narrow and it seems that only one standard size 
cargo ship can pass along the tunnel at the time. There really is no 
room to meet, so you would better stay out of the way when a boat glides 
by. North and south is your choise of way and you should hurry before 
three is a boat coming.

Rooms.Name: A water channel
Rooms.Description:
The submountain water channel goes north or south in a narrow dug out 
tunnel, where there is no room for you AND a boat. So it is strongly 
suggested to keep out of the way, when the cargo ships glide by at a very 
short distance. The sound of the ships fog horns can be a signal about a 
incoming danger, but far from all use that feat.

Rooms.Name: A Final room - filled with comments
Rooms.Description:

Mobs.Name: dervish raggity
Mobs.LongDescription: A raggity dervish walks on aimlessly.
Mobs.Description: Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use some rest.

Mobs.Name: dervish large
Mobs.LongDescription: A large dervish watches for signs of trouble.
Mobs.Description: Dressed in loose fitting rags, this man looks like he could use LOTS of rest.

Mobs.Name: snake coral
Mobs.LongDescription: A brightly colored snake slithers along the sands.
Mobs.Description:
This relatively harmless snake has bright alternating bands of red, yellow
and black.

Mobs.Name: scorpion small
Mobs.LongDescription: A small, red scorpion scuttles away at your approach.
Mobs.Description: The little tail is mighty dangerous for such a small creature.

Mobs.Name: worm giant purple
Mobs.LongDescription: A giant, purple sand worm thrusts up out of the sand and attacks!
Mobs.Description: He's big, mean, and purple.  Watch out!

Mobs.Name: dragon brass
Mobs.LongDescription:
A very large brass dragon steps out of the darkness and says "Hello".
Then adds to it, "Prepare to die, have a nice day!"

Mobs.Name: nomad leader
Mobs.LongDescription: The nomad leader sits silently in prayer.
Mobs.Description:
He is clad in silk robes lined with gold thread. At his side is a large,
engraved cutlass.  He has an especially haughty air about him.

Mobs.Name: nomad commander
Mobs.LongDescription: The nomad commander stands here staring at you suspiciously.
Mobs.Description:
This is the nomad leader's second in command.  His clothes are richly woven
of silk and gold thread.  A nasty cutlass hangs at his side.

Mobs.Name: nomad warrior
Mobs.LongDescription: A proud nomad warrior stands here.

Mobs.Name: slave young
Mobs.LongDescription: A young slave sits here staring at you with pleading eyes.

Mobs.Name: dracolich lich
Mobs.LongDescription: A pile of bones rises up to form a skeletal dracolich.
Mobs.Description:
The dracolich is now only bone with pieces of flesh hanging from it.
Obviously it no longer fears death.

Mobs.Name: drider drow
Mobs.LongDescription: The drider looks at you viciously while it draws its sword.
Mobs.Description: This half-spider, half-drow creature is a formidable opponent.

Mobs.Name: duergar dark dwarf
Mobs.LongDescription: A duergar is here mining precious stones with his pick.
Mobs.Description: The duergar could crush your head as easily as it does those rocks.

Mobs.Name: myconoid
Mobs.Description:
The myconoid looks something like a giant mushroom (and probably has the same
effect).

Mobs.Name: myconoid shaman
Mobs.LongDescription: A rather large myconoid stands here chanting in a strange tongue.
Mobs.Description: The shaman shoots spores into the air.

Mobs.Name: dustdigger
Mobs.LongDescription: A small oasis invites you to dive in.

Mobs.Name: camel rabid
Mobs.LongDescription: A very dangerous rabid camel snorts at you.
